A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the accuracy of sum-frequency generation (SFG) is limited by that of DFG, while that of DFG is not affected by the accuracy of SFG.
the DFG comb can serve as a simple and stable optical frequency comb for the generation of optical frequencies in a broad spectral range.
the DFG comb is a very promising approach for the development of an offset-free optical clockwork.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the accuracy of DFG is not limited by the phase noise of the input comb but by the accuracy of sum-frequency generation.
DFG in nonlinear crystals offers an alternative route to optical frequency combs with vanishing offset frequency and thus potentially higher accuracy.
the DFG comb can be used as a stable and accurate optical clockwork for the generation of infrared frequency combs.
